<!-- roadmap-slicer:edda-story-led-srd-521:issue:world-summon -->

Epic: #54 · Roadmap: #47 · Investigation: #82

Source: [pinned SRD 5.2.1, PDF pp. 129–130, 254–257, 358](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf). Pin and attribution: `docs/srd-5.2.1-conformance.md`. Decision: `docs/investigations/issue-82-world-expansion.md`.

**Spike: one working session, decision and bounded follow-up issues; no production implementation.**

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In one working session, decide and publish one-PR tasks for the Find Familiar/Owl instance-control slice: cast cost, ownership, initiative, no-attack restriction, dismissal, Owl traits and durable replay.
- [ ] Coordinate with #80 and #77 and add the actual spell/effect prerequisites before implementation. Preserve explicit unsupported status until those prerequisites exist. No production code in this investigation.

## Blocked by

- #80 Split remaining SRD spells, items and effects into PR-sized batches
- #148 Run a Bandit attack from its pinned stat block through durable encounters

## Verification

- `go test -short -race ./...` and `go vet ./...`.
